thread:
matt: Rotary shift checking in — quick snapshot before I sign out. Current top items:

matt: 1) Routing error spike on eu-west1 -> ~5% 5xxs for /v1/generate since 02:12 UTC. Alert triggered at 02:10.

ops-bot: ALERT: route.service.euwest1.5xx rate > 3% for 5m (threshold=3%)

sara: I saw that, looks like a bad canary binding to an older kernel on a couple pods. I removed the canary tag from model-service-canary-42 at 02:18.

matt: Current mitigation: 1) rolled back canary on eu-west1 to stable (done), 2) scaled model-service stable pool +2 replicas to drain requests. Latency returned to baseline ~02:22.

jin: Logs I checked: several "KV cache miss + kernel fallback" traces around 02:11-02:15. Example snippet:
```
[02:12:03] model-service-canary-42: kernel_select failed -> fallback=softfloat
[02:12:03] request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=500 msg="kernel mismatch"
```

devon: Follow-ups: we should confirm no incomplete KV flushes caused cache evictions. I'm running a quick check against kvcache-metrics for the period.

matt: Other items: embed ingestion backlog in eu-west queue is creeping up — +120s median delay (ingest-worker). Not critical but worth watching.

sara: Ingest backlog timeline: spike started 01:40 UTC after a burst from a partner test. I paused partner replay at 02:05 and injected backpressure; backlog feeding is steady now.

ops-bot: DEPLOY BOT: Deployment model-service v2.14 started at 02:45 UTC for us-east1 (no impact on eu-west).

matt: Open action items before handoff:
- matt: leave rollout paused for eu-west model-service until tomorrow morning (checked)
- jin: verify kvcache eviction logs and share brief findings in this thread (ETA 15m)
- devon: run a quick end-to-end traffic replay in staging to confirm kernel selection matrix (ETA 1h)
- sara: add a Canary gating note to the runbook (minor)

jin: taking the kvcache check now, will post tail of logs and count of eviction events.

devon: staging replay scheduled at 03:30 UTC (I've notified infra to expect temporary higher load).

sara: No PagerDuty escalations. No customer-facing impact reported yet. I'll update if partner replays resume.

matt: handoff: i'm off at 03:20 UTC. Next oncall @sara — pinged you in case you want to take the bridge if the eu-west spike reappears.

sara: Got it — I'll be watching for any reoccurrence and will stand up a bridge if 5xx > 2% persists for 10m. Thanks, matt. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: NOTE: Incident Log created -> INC-2026-042: eu-west1 routing spike, started 2934006660 (auto).

matt: quick FYI — saved the rollback diff in #deploys: `git log --oneline --stat` under 02-18-eu-west-rollback for traceability.

jin: kvcache quick result: eviction count +3x during spike window, correlated to a large prefix churn. Posting filtered tail here:
```
[02:14:01] kvcache: evict key shard=7 count=128
[02:14:02] kvcache: evict key shard=3 count=96
```

jin: conclusion: eviction spike likely exacerbated kernel fallback on a subset of canary pods. Will add to incident notes.

sara: I'll attach a short playbook step: if canary causes kernel mismatch -> rollback + scale stable + monitor kvcache eviction rate for 15m.

matt: thanks team. Leaving context: if you need me, I'm on mobile until 04:00 UTC. Otherwise see you all tomorrow for postmortem triage if needed.

sara: Copy. Taking over.

devon: ack — monitoring staging run.

ops-bot: SHIFT HANDOFF: oncall user changed to sara at 03:20 UTC
